audit.source_question:
As shown in the figure, AC = BC, AD bisects angle CAB, then the perimeter of triangle DBE is ()
Choices:
A:6cm
B:7cm
C:8cm
D:9cm
audit.independent_solution: Let E be the perpendicular foot from D to AB. The two right triangles ACD and AED share AD and have equal angle at A, so CD=DE and AC=AE. Since AC=BC, DB+DE=BC and EB=AB−AE=AB−AC. Their sum is AB=6 cm (A).
